Correction: pulled the verified Catalina Crunch Protein Cereal (Chocolate Peanut Butter) reference from the recipe library (intake/recipes/catalina_crunch_choc_pb_cereal.json, added by the recipe-analyzer session) — 306kcal/31g protein/44g carb/14g fat/25g fiber per 100g, label-verified. Replaces the earlier generic estimate; day totals updated accordingly.

13:00 lunch: 280g fat-trimmed sirloin steak (standard reference) + 150g baked potatoes in olive oil (whole batch: 320g raw potato + 20g olive oil added prebake, fully eaten — same whole-batch-from-raw-inputs method as the 14 Aug roasted-potato entry, since baking only loses water weight, not calories). Credits ~1.08mg vitamin E.

Correction: 320g was the potato's BAKED weight (raw weight not known), not raw — and 150g was only a portion eaten out of that 320g batch, not the whole thing. Recomputed using the standard baked-potato-w/-skin reference (~93kcal/100g) for the 150/320 potato fraction, plus the same 150/320 fraction of the 20g olive oil (added prebake over the whole batch). Day totals updated accordingly.
13:45 Omega-3 fish oil (2 softgels, ~1000mg EPA/DHA) — clears today's omega-3 target.

14:00 "essential 5" (Advance Physician Formulas Vitamin C+D3+E+Zinc+Selenium, 2 capsules) — 1000mg vitamin C, 2000IU vitamin D, 134mg vitamin E, 20mg zinc, 100mcg selenium. Clears today's zinc, selenium, and vitamin D targets.
16:30 double espresso (2 caffeine shots, bringing today's total to 3).
17:15 Outdoor Walk, Or Akiva, 2.2km/30min, concluded 17:45. Logged to data.js/workouts.json — ACWR now 0.92 (comfortably in range), recommended next session still Legs day.

Sun-exposure vitamin D estimate for the walk (rough/low-confidence, per the standing sun-exposure method): full 30min duration assumed exposed (no partial-exposure fraction given), moderate area (~30 IU/min, typical walking attire — arms/legs/face). Discounted ~60% for late-afternoon sun (17:15-17:45, well past solar noon, closer to dusk) and ~50% for the 30 SPF sunscreen applied to exposed skin (partial real-world block, not lab-perfect). Net estimate: 30 × 30 × 0.40 × 0.50 = 180 IU, folded directly into vitamin_d_iu rather than logged as a separate item — flag if any of these assumptions should be adjusted.

All standard/verified references.
Added 10 more cherry tomatoes to the salad (30 total now), no additional dressing — updated the salad item and day totals (now credits ~13.2mg lycopene, ~72.23mg vitamin C, ~76.5mcg folate DFE).
